semantics.arrival: Fixed seeded request sequence, barrier-synchronized waves of C clients, next wave after all responses; HTTP scheduling/admission order and rejection count are not deterministic.
semantics.measurement: P0 measure() times complete rounds; warmup rounds excluded from request records; request p50/p95/p99 are separate NumPy linear quantiles over successful requests.
semantics.wait: Server queue admission to inference start; excludes HTTP/socket parsing. Client E2E covers connection through full response. Rejections retain E2E but have no inference wait.
semantics.stream: SSE meta/token/done/error; token_ids include the entire prompt; client records TTFT from request start. eos_id defaults to null.
semantics.comparison: T3 nominal parameters: serial batch_size=1, batch_timeout_ms=0, same queue capacity and length distributions; offered rate is requests / measured round wall time. T3 uses Poisson arrivals, HTTP uses closed-loop waves, so compare distributions only, never per-request trajectories. T3 retains its P0 uncached analytical service proxy; it is not calibrated cached HTTP cost.
semantics.limits: Loopback CPU small-model engineering evidence; no production performance claim; tracemalloc instrumentation and local clients share this process. Slow SSE clients backpressure the single inference worker.
